title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
马寻现在有些一言难尽了，本来以为自己可以出宫了，但是现在变成了在皇宫里干活。好消息是得到了自由，现在要去的地方不少，不用整天都在陪太子读书了。坏消息就成为了‘保姆’，准确的来说是保健医生，现在要做的事情自然也不算少了。现在如今这座皇宫是三年前开始建造，当时是以精通堪舆术的刘伯温为首选择了这个风水宝地，发动二十万人填燕雀湖建宫。皇宫不用说，自然是富丽堂皇、气势巍峨，也遵循礼制、呼应天象、顺应自然，没得挑剔。这毕竟是故宫的模板，奠定了后世的一些建筑风格。但是马寻觉得地势有点低，而且在填湖造宫的情况下，也有点潮湿。东宫前的梅林以迅雷不及掩耳之势被砍了，后花园的那些花也被砍了，很多人都搞不清楚发生了什么。然后太医院那般传出来了一些消息，陛下震怒责罚了一些太医，幸亏皇后和太子保护，这才么有杀人。马寻这个国舅爷又一次被人认知了，小道消息就是他诊出皇后和太子有疾，一时间人心惶惶。至于爵位等没有立刻封赏，千说万劝总算暂时拦下来了。老朱之所以答应倒不是熄了封赏的心，而是他原本就打算等到北伐成功之后大封功臣，不出意外的话就是明年的事情了。到时候一起封，虽然对开国功臣的封爵有了初步的排序、计划，但是还要进一步的完善。沐英看到马寻的时候直接跪下，“外甥给舅舅磕头了，若是皇后有恙，我不及尽孝，万死莫赎！”马寻赶紧扶起来沐英，“像什么话！皇后是我姐，用得着你这样！”沐英还是心有余悸，抹着泪说道，“皇后与我有活命之恩，若非殿下抚育，岂能有我今日！”“真想给皇后做点事情，你安排人去广东。”马寻说道，“那边好像有一味药叫做化橘红，化痰止咳，那玩意儿看着像柑橘。”马寻仔细看过一些草药，没有找到化橘红，他也着急。《本草纲目》还没出来呢，以后的一些贡品现在也没出现。沐英立刻认真起来，“舅舅，您细说，俺仔细听着。”沐英在认真记着，身边的小太监也在记着，而一个小侍女悄然跑走。朱元璋来了，激动万分的问道，“小弟，你找到了奇药？”“不算奇药，稍微有点用。”马寻顿时头疼，赶紧解释，“姐夫，您派人去广东，那边有些人该知道这玩意儿。我叫它化橘红，不知道其他人怎么称呼。”朱元璋欣慰的拍了拍马寻的手，“小弟，以后有这类东西，你只管安排人去取，不怕找不到。”马寻不怕找不到这些东西，他怕的是空欢喜一场，到时候没办法交差，他又不是正经医生。

在如今这个年代，一场感冒说不定就能要人的命，更何况是以后即使医学水平有了极大的提升，依然无法根治的哮喘呢！看到马寻要出宫，老朱又要嫌弃了，“你姐和你外甥病着，你倒是想要出去找媳妇，你倒是好大的心！”马寻忙不跌的说道，“姐夫，姐和太子没病，没多大的事，小心护理就好。您别自己吓唬自己，更别吓唬他们，心情好了、不受累，自然就好了！”朱元璋也立刻点头，自家妹子和好大儿虽然有气疾，但是不严重、不影响生活等等，这就行。他怕的就是自家妹子像长孙皇后那样，这都有点应激、反应过度了。看着朱元璋，马寻问道，“姐夫，我现在还能不能出宫？”朱元璋立刻催促起来，“去啊，快些去！你要是看不中刘基那老匹夫的闺女，回来和俺说！”在内心深处，他还是希望马寻看不上刘伯温的女儿。只是碍于皇后和太子的意见，所以暂时只能捏着鼻子认了。要是马寻也反对，那就可以偷着乐。给小舅子找个好生养的多好，找个娇娇弱弱的大家闺秀，哪像是种田人家该有的样。传宗接代才是第一位，膀大腰圆就算了，起码得大腚好生养啊！昂昂昂朱元璋嫌弃的看了一眼旁边的傻驴，“蠢东西，除了叫就会吃！”马寻补充一句，“还闲不住，出门就得带着它。”朱元璋笑了起来，“倒也通人性。”对于马寻这个小舅子，朱元璋是越来越喜欢了。性子好、守本分，还救了皇后和太子。现在也不像最初那样时时刻刻恪守本分、小心翼翼，多了些亲近，是真的成了一家人，不用时刻拘束着了。朱元璋对沐英吩咐说道，“护好你舅舅，他一身功夫稀疏平常，遇到狠一点的就招架不住。”沐英连忙保证，“陛下放心，臣就是豁出性命也护着舅舅安全！”“我就是去看看媳妇，怎么说的好像是要打仗了？”马寻不理解了，“真要是这么凶险，我去找大姐夫说话，我去逗景隆。”朱元璋不说话了，他要是坏了马寻的好事，皇后要跟他拼命。马寻的婚事，这可是大事！再次出宫的马寻看着街上的行人说道，“应天府到底是京城，富贵繁华。”沐英骄傲说道，“应天府本就是江南重镇，陛下夺得这里已经十四年了。
content_en:
Ma Xun is a little speechless now. He originally thought he could leave the palace, but now he has to work in the palace.The good news is that I have gained my freedom. Now I have many places to go, and I no longer have to spend all day studying with the prince.The bad news has become the 'nanny', to be precise, the health doctor, who naturally has a lot to do now.Now, the construction of this palace started three years ago. At that time, Liu Bowen, who was proficient in Kanyu art, chose this geomantic treasure land and mobilized 200,000 people to fill Yanque Lake to build the palace.Needless to say, the palace is naturally magnificent and majestic. It also follows etiquette, echoes the celestial phenomena, and conforms to nature. There is no need to be picky.After all, this is the template for the Forbidden City, which laid the foundation for some architectural styles of later generations.But Ma Xun felt that the terrain was a bit low, and with the lake being filled in to build the palace, it was also a bit damp.The plum grove in front of the East Palace was chopped down with lightning speed, and the flowers in the back garden were also chopped down. Many people were confused about what happened.Then some news came out from the Imperial Hospital, and His Majesty was furious and punished some of the Imperial doctors. Fortunately, the Queen and the Crown Prince protected them, and no one was killed.Ma Xun, the uncle of the country, was recognized again. The rumor was that he diagnosed the queen and the prince with illness, which made people panic for a while.As for the knighthood and other rewards that were not immediately awarded, he finally stopped it temporarily after many persuasion.The reason why Lao Zhu agreed was not because he had no intention of awarding him a reward, but because he had originally planned to wait until the Northern Expedition was successful to award him the title of meritorious official. If nothing else, it would be next year.When the time comes, they will be granted titles together. Although there is a preliminary order and plan for the titles of the founding heroes, they still need to be further improved.When Mu Ying saw Ma Xun, she knelt down and said, "My nephew kowtows to my uncle. If the Queen is ill, I will not fulfill my filial piety. I will not redeem myself until I die!" Ma Xun quickly helped Mu Ying up, "What are you talking about! The Queen is my sister, so she needs you to do this!" Mu Ying was still frightened, wiping her tears and said, "The Queen and I have a chance to survive.Well, if it hadn't been for His Majesty's care, I wouldn't be where I am today!" "I really want to do something for the Queen, please arrange for someone to go to Guangdong." Ma Xun said, "There seems to be a medicine there called Hua Juhong, which can reduce phlegm and relieve coughs.It looks like citrus." Ma Xun looked carefully at some herbs and couldn't find Hua Juhong.The "Compendium of Materia Medica" has not yet come out, and some of the future tributes have not yet appeared.Mu Ying immediately became serious, "Uncle, please explain in detail, I will listen carefully." Mu Ying was memorizing it carefully, and the little eunuch beside her was also memorizing it, while a little maid ran away quietly.Zhu Yuanzhang came and asked excitedly, "Brother, have you found a miracle medicine?" "It's not a miracle medicine, it's a little bit useful." Ma Xun suddenly had a headache and quickly explained, "Brother-in-law, you sent someone to Guangdong. Some people there should know about this thing. I call it orange red. I don't know about others.What do you call it?" Zhu Yuanzhang patted Ma Xun's hand happily and said, "Brother, if there are such things in the future, just arrange for someone to pick them up.Don't be afraid that you won't find them." Ma Xun is not afraid of not being able to find these things. What he is afraid of is that he will be happy in vain and will not be able to deliver the work. He is not a serious doctor.

In this day and age, a cold may kill someone, not to mention asthma, which is still incurable even if medical standards have greatly improved in the future!Seeing that Ma Xun was about to leave the palace, Lao Zhu felt disgusted again, "Your sister and your nephew are sick, but you want to go out to find a wife. You are so generous!" Ma Xun said hurriedly, "Brother-in-law, sister and the prince are not sick. It's nothing serious. Take good care of them.That's fine. Don't scare yourself, let alone them.If you're in a good mood and don't feel tired, it will be fine!" Zhu Yuanzhang also nodded immediately. Although his sister and the elder son have gas diseases, they are not serious and do not affect their lives. That's fine.What he was afraid of was that his sister would be like Empress Changsun, who would be a bit stressed and overreacted.Looking at Zhu Yuanzhang, Ma Xun asked, "Brother-in-law, can I still leave the palace now?" Zhu Yuanzhang immediately urged, "Go, hurry up! If you don't like Liu Ji's daughter, that old man, come back and tell me!" Deep in his heart, he still hoped that Ma Xun would not like Liu Bowen's daughter.However, due to the opinions of the Queen and the Prince, I can only hold my nose and admit it for the time being.If Ma Xun also objects, then he can have some fun.It would be great to find a good mother-in-law for my brother-in-law, a delicate and frail lady, not what a farming family should be like.Carrying on the family lineage is the first priority. Forget about being big and round, at least you should have a big butt for fertility!Zhu Yuanzhang glanced at the silly donkey next to him with disgust, "Stupid thing, it can only eat when it barks!" Ma Xun added, "It's still too busy, so I have to take it with me when I go out." Zhu Yuanzhang laughed, "It's quite human nature." Zhu Yuanzhang liked Ma Xun more and more as his brother-in-law.He has a good temper, keeps his duties, and even saves the queen and the prince.Now we are no longer as strict and careful as we were at the beginning. We are closer and we have truly become a family, no longer restricted by restraints.Zhu Yuanzhang told Mu Ying, "Protect your uncle. His martial arts are mediocre and he won't be able to resist someone who is more ruthless." Mu Ying quickly assured, "Don't worry, Your Majesty, I will risk my life to protect my uncle's safety!" "I'm just going to see you."Look at my wife, why did she say that there is going to be a war?"Ma Xun didn't understand, "If it's really so dangerous, I'll go talk to my eldest brother-in-law, and I'll tease Jinglong."Zhu Yuanzhang stopped talking. If he ruins Ma Xun's good deeds, the queen will fight with him.Ma Xun's marriage is a big deal!Ma Xun, who came out of the palace again, looked at the passers-by on the street and said, "Yingtian Mansion is the capital after all, rich and prosperous." Mu Ying said proudly, "Yingtian Mansion is an important town in the south of the Yangtze River, and it has been fourteen years since your Majesty captured it.
